integrity: The universal inequality is proved analytically from the published extremal-family description and central-interval property. Exact rational computation is used only as a replayable consistency check, not as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats exactly two summands and positive parameters; it does not settle the unrestricted three-or-more-summand case of Conjecture 6.1.
The endpoint parameter \(\alpha=0\) is excluded because the finite-support canonical-cell representation is not defined there.
title: The two-summand case of the variance-equalization concentration conjecture
